sources.note: Database versioning help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: Preview changes are colour-coded SAFE (green), CAUTION (yellow), DANGER (red).
SAFE cannot lose data; CAUTION needs review (e.g. NOT NULL over existing NULLs); DANGER can lose data (drop column, type change).
claims.supports: SAFE ... CAUTION ... NOT NULL ... DANGER ... dropping columns or changing types

claims.statement: Danger levels are customizable per change type in Tools > Database Versioning > Diff Changes.
claims.supports: Danger levels customizable under Tools > Database Versioning > Diff Changes
